name: Naumburg (Saale, Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Naumburg (Saale) (a crossed key and sword on white).
history: According to the city charter the flag is a red and white bicolour with the arms; the stripes run horizontally in the transverse form and vertically in the longitudinal form, in the ratio 1:1.

features.role: Naumburg arms — key and sword on white
